name.en: A village in the Lake District
name.it: Un villaggio nel Distretto dei Laghi

about.en: A dale village among the fells of the Lake District in Cumbria, between Keswick and Grasmere: Borrowdale and Derwentwater, the tarns and becks, drystone walls and slate cottages, packhorse bridges, Herdwick sheep, the shows and the shepherds' meets, tatie pot, Grasmere gingerbread and sticky toffee pudding; Wordsworth and Beatrix Potter as light touches. British English, with Slovene, Italian and German for learners of English from those languages.

review: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

tutor.setting: My Village, {learner}'s village in a dale of the Lake District in Cumbria, among the fells between Keswick and Grasmere
tutor.style: Lake District style (a Cumbrian dale: fells, becks and tarns, drystone walls, Herdwick sheep; English first names and Cumbrian surnames; simple, kind British English)
tutor.voice: A native British English speaker from Cumbria in the Lake District, speaking clear standard English with a light northern Cumbrian accent, warm, friendly and unhurried.
